_comment: PER-AREA MONSTER TABLE (LEDGER debt row 77, first payment, M4-S3): the spawn rows MonsterField builds, replacing the M4-slice code constant {mchy: pokrzywnik}. One entry per area key; each row {kind, count, placement}: kind = a data/monsters.json key (Sim Attack looks it up there), count = idle sprites in the row, placement = 'near-spawn' (Chebyshev <= 3 from the arrival cell) | 'deep' (>= 5 from it; the 4-ring between may stay empty). An empty band falls back to all walkable cells; a town spawns nothing whatever this file says (isTown gate first). mchy: pokrzywnik count 14 (M4-S4: the level-up beat needs >=11 kills to cross the ladder L1->L2 threshold 500 xp at 40 xp/kill — 14 leaves margin), ponurak (art committed at assets/raw/mon-ponurak-idle.png) roams deep, count 2. Acts 2-5 rows are skeleton-valid placeholders on the first wilderness region of each act. Seed stays Fnv.Hash(area + ':mon'); rows build in file order. Loaded through the GameContext.DataDir() surface; one-way copy to game/data/ — never hand-edit the copy.
